note: Issue #611: rules every race shares. Read by src/systems/racing/race_crew.gd. line_up_reach: how close to the grid (m) your speeder must be for [Z]. countdown_s: seconds per count (3, 2, 1, GO). grid_timeout_s: racers still driving to the grid this long after you line up are set on their slots. beep / go_sound: Sound keys (content/look/sound.json). crowd_profiles: the soldier profiles spectators are drawn from (random local looks). crowd_band: where they stand, beside the start line, [min, max] metres out from each antenna and [min, max] metres behind the line. return_s: after the race, how long the racers have to drive back and park before their speeders are put away. Issue #618: gate_boost_off (0..1, how near a checkpoint's centre counts as clean) and gate_boost (the share of the boost tank it gives back); finish_cam and finish_filter (switches), finish_gap_s (another racer this close to the line in time makes a close finish), finish_slow (time scale), finish_cam_s (real seconds), finish_fov, finish_cam_side_m, finish_filter_look (letterbox bar height, vignette strength, warm tint). Drafting and the boost's camera widening are the speeder's (speeder.json). Issue #617: pink_slips (on or off) and owned_cap, the most speeders you can own (won or kept; never more than the row outside the back gate has spots). collect: Dorrin's prompt for your winnings. Issue #616: seeker_chance_s and mine_chance_s, a racer's chance each second (while it may fight) of firing a seeker at you in its nose or dropping a mine with you within mine_behind_m behind it. hud: the race HUD's words.
